blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Milk is more nourishing than wine.
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее.

exercises.q: Синано ___ (длинный), чем все остальные реки в Японии.
exercises.prompt: The Shinano is longer than any other river in Japan.
exercises.why: Note the use of the preposition "на + Acc." in such expressions as: старше на два года — 2 years older; длиннее на пять метров — 5 meters longer. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Note the use of the preposition "на + Acc." in such expressions as: старше на два года — 2 years older; длиннее на пять метров — 5 meters longer.
